phases.name: repo + secrets + auto-deploy
phases.notes: Repo private, secrets sealed-box encrypted (CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN, CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID), deploy.yml pushes site/ to Pages on every main push. Verified push triggered a deploy run.

phases.name: research + ingestion (copy ClipForge)
phases.notes: Ingestion ported from ClipForge stage_a: jobs/<id>/ingest-request.json -> workflow_dispatch -> aria2/requests/gdrive download -> release asset. 24h TTL via cleanup.yml.

phases.name: auth gate (PAT)
phases.notes: Pages _middleware.js validates x-castcut-pat against GitHub /user; only login==motionssalt passes. Token lives in browser localStorage only.

phases.name: mode 1: faces pipeline
phases.notes: hysts/anime-face-detector (YOLOv3, CPU) + deepghs CCIP embeddings (imgutils) + online centroid clustering (cos thr 0.35). Fallbacks: lbpcascade_animeface + HSV histograms. 1fps sampling, tunable.

phases.name: mode 1: gallery UI + export
phases.notes: Single manifest.json with embedded 112px WebP base64 thumbs; ordered tap-to-select, merge groups, ignore; export = ordered hard-cut concat + x264 CRF23 slow, before/after sizes logged.

phases.name: mode 2: scene pipeline
phases.notes: faster-whisper tiny transcript + ffmpeg scdet 0.35 scene index + 480p screenshots; agent prompt embeds strict JSON schema + scene request.

phases.name: mode 2: UI + JSON import + export
phases.notes: Paste JSON -> scene_export.py validates with numbered errors -> full-quality cut (CRF 14) hard-cut join -> one release file.

phases.name: polish, size checks, README
phases.notes: README covers setup, modes, JSON schema, resume protocol, TTL. All modules py_compile clean.

decisions: Face detector: hysts/anime-face-detector YOLOv3 (CPU) over RetinaFace/FasterRCNN — best accuracy-per-second on free runners; lbpcascade_animeface is fallback only.
Embeddings: deepghs CCIP via imgutils (512-d), cosine threshold 0.35; HSV histogram fallback if model download fails.
Clustering: online nearest-centroid, no sklearn dependency.
Sampling: 1 fps default (tunable 0.5-2), frames scaled to 480p; capped at 3600 frames for long videos.
Thumbnails: 112px WebP q78 base64 embedded in a single manifest.json so the gallery loads in one request.
Storage: GitHub release castcut-<job_id> per job; 24h TTL, hourly cleanup.yml deletes expired releases.
Mode 1 export: ordered per-character, no interleave, no duplicated ranges, hard cuts only, x264 CRF 23 slow final pass (sizes logged).
Mode 2 export: full quality (CRF 14), hard cuts, strict JSON schema v1 with numbered validation errors.
Auth: Pages middleware checks GitHub /user login==motionssalt on every /api/* call; PAT stays client-side.

castcut_unified_flow.notes:
Architecture map of ClipForge adapted to CastCut:
- Stage A: publishes GitHub release (00_READ_THIS_FIRST.txt, screenshots.zip, transcript.json, scene_index.json, video_meta.json, manifest.json). If source >2GB, marks source_omitted: true and re-fetches in Stage B.
- Client UI: prompt is generated instantly client-side pointing to the release and instructions file. Typing a scene description updates prompt live with zero server/Action latency.
- Stage B (scene export): reads production.json, validates schema, re-fetches source, cuts segments at full quality (CRF 14), joins with hard cuts, publishes to release.
- Single intake: one link field auto-detecting URL/Drive/Magnet, plus torrent file with mutual disable.
- Unified parallel execution: Start runs faces and scene analysis in parallel, with independent status reporting and tasks list under project.
